echidnabot.reason: proofs here are gated by their own toolchains (proofs.yml: Idris2, Lean, Agda); no ECHIDNA engine is configured, so this adapter could only ever report not_run

panicbot.reason: panic-attack already reports directly as its own row in the Hypatia verdict grid; enrolling panicbot would count the same findings twice

sustainabot.reason: reserved fleet slot; no adapter exists (gitbot-fleet README)

cipherbot.reason: no cryptography is implemented in this repository; the hashes present are checksum/integrity pins, which cipherbot would report as cryptographic findings

accessibilitybot.reason: no served HTML surface; this is a checker library/CLI with AsciiDoc documentation
